description: Expected Australian Earthquake Hazard (Web Mercator) WMTS is a dataset listed in South Australian Government data directory (data.sa.gov.au), Australia, an open data portal, published or maintained by Geoscience Australia Data. The service contains the 2013 Earthquake Hazard map, as a raster and contours. This map shows the peak ground acceleration (response spectral period of 0. 01 seconds) on rock expected for a 500 year return period, in units of g, evaluated for the geometric mean of the horizontal components. Coverage: South Australia. The portal files it under the publisher Geoscience Australia Data. Its tags are Auistralia, Earth Sciences, Published_External, WMTS, community safety. It offers 2 resource(s) in wmts. The portal shows 2025-10-16 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support infrastructure hazard and exposure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ditrdcsa-data-sa.
